title: 第23章 狂飙的黄子洞第24章 线索
lines: 夕阳下，街道变得静谧。
李骏仰头看着染金的晚霞，问道：“黄哥，那贵人会不会是我们身边的人？”
黄子洞想了想，笑着打趣：“说不定就是你呢，小贵人。”
李骏笑弯了眼：“我？我可没什么贵气儿。
不过，你和潘爷爷，是我的贵人。”
黄子洞听了，摇摇头，语气忽然正经了几分：“贵人，有时候不是谁帮了你一把，而是让你看清自己怎么走的人。”
李骏听得一愣，正想再问什么，却发现黄子洞已经不再说话，只静静望着天边。
“黄大哥，你的贵人，或许，真的是你小时候遇到的仙人......”
走着走着，夜幕降临，星光初现，两人走在城郊，道路逐渐幽暗。
四周出奇安静，连虫鸣都没几声。
李骏突然一顿，眼角余光瞥见前方林中有几道晃动的黑影。
他脸色微变，轻拉黄子洞衣角，低声道：“黄大哥，前头有人。”
黄子洞神情一凛，立刻停下脚步，眼神警惕：“不动，先看看。”
两人迅速后退半步，隐身路旁暗处。
月光下，那几道黑影缓缓走出树林，为首之人身姿挺拔，脸上挂着讥笑——是千草堂的古拉贝。
看到黄子洞发现自己，躲藏了起来，他也直接现身了。
“黄子洞，你真会挑地方，一定要和我撞面。”
黄子洞面色一沉，把玄冰藤交给李骏，随后现身冷声道：“你堂堂古拉贝，也学人躲林子埋伏？千草堂变这德行了？”
古拉贝笑意不减，语气却冷如寒霜：“别废话，那株玄冰藤——你最好乖乖交出来，免得自讨苦吃。”
黄子洞目光一寒，声音铿锵有力，几乎带着怒气砸向地面：
“哼，千草堂也太不讲规矩了吧？这玄冰藤是我药膳坊半月前就定好的，你们现在横插一脚，是想明抢吗？真以为我们药膳坊没人？”
古拉贝轻轻摩挲着双手，语气却透着冷意：“黄子洞，我再说一次，这玄冰藤，是斯木上人钦点之物。
你不给，我也必须留下它。
你若识相交出来，斯木上人说不定还会念你的好日后。”
“别拿斯木上人吓我！”
黄子洞声音一提，猛地向前踏出一步，浑身气势凌厉，“我不会交出来的，你若动手，我就告官了！”
古拉贝眼中闪过一抹寒光，还未开口，他身后的青年已冷笑出声：“黄子洞，识相点。
贵坊通个情，也不至于丢脸。”
“通情？”
黄子洞目光锋利如刀，“规矩是先来后到，信义为重。
想要玄冰藤？行啊——回头你们自己找我们坊主借去，别在这儿撒野！”
话音未落，他一把拽住李骏，转身便冲。
古拉贝脸色骤冷，厉声一喝：“别让他们跑了！
给我拦住他！
黄子洞——我要亲手调教调教！”
几名彪形大汉闻声飞扑而上，铁棍破风，“呼呼”
作响，场面顿时火药味十足！
content_en:
Under the setting sun, the streets became quiet.
Li Jun looked up at the golden sunset and asked, "Brother Huang, could that noble person be someone around us?"
Huang Zidong thought for a while, smiled and joked: "Maybe it's you, little noble man."
Li Jun smiled and rolled his eyes: "Me? I'm not very noble.
However, you and Grandpa Pan are my nobles. "
Huang Zidong listened, shook his head, and his tone suddenly became more serious: "My lord, sometimes it's not the person who helps you, but the person who lets you see your way clearly."
Li Jun was stunned when he heard this. He was about to ask something more, but found that Huang Zidong had stopped talking and was just looking at the horizon quietly.
"Brother Huang, maybe your noble person is really the immortal you met when you were a child..."
As they walked, night fell and the stars first appeared. The two of them walked on the outskirts of the city, and the road gradually became darker.
The surroundings were eerily quiet, not even a few insects chirping.
Li Jun paused suddenly, and out of the corner of his eye he caught a glimpse of several dark shadows shaking in the forest ahead.
His face changed slightly, he gently pulled the corner of Huang Zidong's clothes, and whispered: "Brother Huang, there is someone in front."
Huang Zidong looked stern and immediately stopped, his eyes wary: "Don't move, let's take a look first."
The two quickly took half a step back and hid in the darkness beside the road.
Under the moonlight, those dark shadows slowly walked out of the woods. The person leading them stood tall and straight, with a sneer on his face - it was Gulabei from Qiancaotang.
Seeing Huang Zidong discovering him and hiding, he also appeared directly.
"Huang Zidong, you are really good at picking places. You must meet me."
Huang Zidong's face darkened, and he handed the Xuan Bing Teng to Li Jun. Then he appeared and said coldly: "You, your majestic Gulabei, also learn how to hide in the woods and ambush? Has Qiancaotang changed to this virtue?"
Gulabe's smile did not diminish, but his tone was as cold as frost: "Stop talking nonsense, that Black Ice Vine - you'd better hand it over obediently, so as not to ask for trouble."
Huang Zidong's eyes turned cold, his voice was sonorous and powerful, and he almost hit the ground with anger:
"Hmph, Qiancaotang is too unruly, isn't it? This Xuanbingvine was ordered by my herbal diet shop half a month ago. Are you trying to steal it by interfering now? Do you really think there is no one in our herbal diet shop?"
Gulabe gently rubbed his hands, but his tone was cold: "Huang Zidong, let me say it again, this Xuanbing Vine was specially ordered by Master Simu.
If you don't give it, I must keep it.
If you come to know each other, Master Simu might still wish you a good future. "
"Don't scare me with Master Simu!"
Huang Zidong raised his voice and took a step forward with a fierce aura, "I won't hand it over. If you do it, I will sue the government!"
A cold light flashed in Gulabei's eyes, and before he could speak, the young man behind him sneered: "Huang Zidong, you know the point of recognition.
It won't be embarrassing if you have a common understanding with Guifang. "
"To be understanding?"
Huang Zidong's eyes were as sharp as a knife, "The rules are first come, first served, and integrity is paramount.
Want Xuanbingvine? Okay - you can borrow it from our boss later, don't act wild here! "
Before he finished speaking, he grabbed Li Jun, turned around and rushed.
Gulabe's face suddenly turned cold and he shouted sternly: "Don't let them run away!
Stop him!
Huang Zidong——I want to train him with my own hands! "
Several burly men heard the sound and flew forward, their iron rods breaking the wind, "Whoosh!"
There was a loud noise, and the scene suddenly became full of gunpowder!
